verdict.rationale: The evidence describes no conversational AI assistant inside Canny's own UI. The closest built-in capability is Autopilot, which automatically extracts feature requests from call transcripts and support or sales sources. Users can also hand conversations to Autopilot, but only through the MCP server from external LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor), so the agent-style delegation happens outside the product. Missing for 10: an in-product AI assistant that accepts user-delegated tasks, documentation of in-app task delegation beyond automated feedback capture, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
